gaps.finding: SNAP 2 IT explicitly lists battery holder 6SCB10, and circuit artwork shows B10.
gaps.cause: The earlier inventory relied on chat excerpts and a small seeded database; the game manual's parts table had not been reconciled with the B-series thread.
gaps.action: Restore B10 / 6SCB10; keep separate from B1, B5, B9 and B11.

gaps.finding: No convincing B8 / 6SCB8 evidence in the sources audited.
gaps.cause: A numbering gap is not proof that a production part existed or that its number was unused.
gaps.action: Keep an unresolved research question; do not manufacture a B8 inventory record.

gaps.finding: Local MyHome and MyHome PLUS PDFs contained only Part 1. Their parts tables are in later sections.
gaps.cause: The downloaded first sections have contents pages referring to pages outside the actual PDF. Searching only those local files cannot recover the parts lists.
gaps.action: Recovered all four missing sections from Elenco. Restored light covers, colored grids, supports and stabilizers.

gaps.finding: SC-100_REV-J_LR.pdf is a 23-page Explorer projects 72-130 supplement; its cover says 753113WEB / REV-A. It contains no parts table.
gaps.cause: Filename and linked website model are insufficient to identify the PDF's actual content.
gaps.action: Retain the actual cover identity; do not treat it as a complete Jr. inventory. Older SC100 full manual is inventoried separately.

gaps.finding: Duplicate filenames can refer to identical document contents.
gaps.cause: The same book is saved under document numbers, kit names, upgrade-kit names and revision-looking filenames.
gaps.action: Preserve every filename and Drive URL as a source alias, but count identical file contents once. Different filenames do not establish different editions.

gaps.finding: Soccer Shot lists a scoring module as 6SCU35; Snap & Draw lists a sound module as 6SCU35.
gaps.cause: The manufacturer's published tables assign the same apparent number to different functions. Snap & Draw also contains placeholder model and photo text.
gaps.action: Keep both observations under a conflict. Do not assume they are interchangeable or apply a single functional tag.

gaps.finding: The Light Tower sheet pairs D8 / Color LED with part number 6SCD1. The printed PDF visually confirms the mismatch.
gaps.cause: Source-table error, rather than a text-extraction artifact. The sheet also contains a 753XXX placeholder.
gaps.action: Flag that kit-membership row; retain D1 and D8 as separate parts backed by other sources.

gaps.finding: The Green Energy Lab sheet prints model SC-GMPLY, red jumper SKU SCCJ2 and wind-fan SKU 6SCSM4B; other manuals list the fan as 6SCM4B.
gaps.cause: Copy/template or numbering inconsistencies in the original published material; the PDF visually confirms these strings.
gaps.action: Do not convert these inconsistencies into new physical parts or kit relationships without independent evidence.

gaps.finding: Soccer Shot's table prints 6SCDD14 for the D14 infrared LED, with a double D.
gaps.cause: Possible manufacturer typo or nonstandard SKU. The extra D is visible in the PDF, so it is not silently corrected as OCR.
gaps.action: Preserve the literal number as provisional; verify canonical order number before confirmation.

gaps.finding: ?1 / ?Q / ?U8 have PY and question-mark order-number aliases. A 9TLC fragment is a broken 9TLCI73 line. One institutional list prints 6CS02-6CS07. Older ads print 9JWSC10 instead of 9SCJW10.
gaps.cause: Legacy numbering, source typos, line breaks and font/text extraction can create false new items.
gaps.action: Keep the documented ?/PY alias pairs together. Reject 9TLC as a separate SKU. Retain 6CS and 9JWSC10 spellings as review evidence, not automatically distinct physical parts.

gaps.finding: BRIC LIGHT, Soccer Shot, Magnet Fun Lab, Light Tower and Snap & Draw manuals were absent from the local Drive set.
gaps.cause: The local collection predates newer website additions.
gaps.action: Added the five new manuals and four missing MyHome sections to the audit; keep revision and draft caveats visible.

gaps.finding: The 2024 catalog advertises Holiday Ornament SCSNSFS1. A marketing appearance alone does not establish normal retail release or its complete parts inventory.
gaps.cause: Marketing, prototype and released-product evidence have different scopes.
gaps.action: Retain as an announced product with unconfirmed release status; do not infer a verified kit inventory.

gaps.finding: The MEGA 200 PDF front matter prints 753285 while its final page prints Part # 753300. The former also occurs on LIGHT material.
gaps.cause: Conflicting identifiers in the published PDF make a single cover-derived manual ID unreliable.
gaps.action: Retain both observed document numbers for review instead of silently choosing one canonical manual identity.

gaps.finding: The inventory contains order numbers, legacy aliases, variants and accessory numbers. Several physical revisions share a number; some alternate numbers identify the same part.
gaps.cause: A manufacturer order number is not a universally unique physical-part identity.
gaps.action: Keep number-record totals separate from distinct-part totals. Tags preserve unresolved identities and source conflicts.

tag_schema.semantics: OR within a field; AND across fields. Unknown is explicit, not an assertion.
